Name: Hardmode Mod
Author: CloakedYoshi
Description:
A mod that makes the game progression slower, and more difficult to complete, . Made for seasoned players of the game. 
*Crops Profits Decreased (Some underpriced crops were buffed though)
*Bundles modified changes/added better rewards
*Monster damage doubled
*Building prices & materials changed
*More difficult crafting recipes
*Mail rewards
For v1.1 of Stardew Valley
